label: Toast
description: Displays transient toast notifications at Page or application scope.

shown.description: Emitted when a toast becomes visible.

closed.description: Emitted when a toast is closed, cleared, or expires.

show.description: Displays a toast notification. When a Page is supplied, the toast belongs to that Page; otherwise it is application-scoped.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Toast presentation, lifetime, and ownership options.

type.description: Notice type used to present the toast.

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds before automatic dismissal. Zero or a negative value disables automatic dismissal.

page.description: Owning Page. When supplied, the toast is rendered in that Page's visual surface; when omitted, the toast is application-scoped.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the toast to close.

clear.description: Closes visible toasts. When a Page is supplied, only toasts owned by that Page are closed; when omitted, all toasts are closed.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional Page whose toasts should be closed.
